description: Main application component and route guarding logic for the frontend of the Career Navigator project. Contains layout structure, navigation, authentication, and admin privilege management.

classes.name: SessionState
classes.description: Represents session data for authentication, including user ID and email.

classes.name: AppAuthState
classes.description: Application-wide authentication state including user info and admin status.

classes.name: GuardedRouteProps
classes.description: Props for the route guard component, indicating required authentication and admin privileges.

methods.name: setAppAuthState
methods.description: Updates the global app auth state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: useIsAdmin
methods.description: React hook to derive and subscribe to admin status from global state.

methods.name: AuthGuard
methods.description: Component that guards route access based on authentication and admin privileges.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component with layout, navigation, and route handling, including authentication, theme, and admin resolution.

methods.name: resolveIsAdmin
methods.description: Function that determines if the current user has admin privileges by checking metadata and admin_users table.

methods.name: handleSignOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user from the session.
